string.text: Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
19 round magazine
Extended magazine (19 rounds) increases your chances of hitting the enemy without reloading.
33 round magazine
High capacity magazine may decrease the number of reloads in combat, thus increasing the chances of hitting the enemy.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Threaded barrel
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a 9x19mm suppressor.
Integrated compensator
Extended barrel with an integrated compensator significantly reduces felt recoil.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Full-auto mode

Completely new slide with a modified trigger group enables fully automatic firing mode. Due to significantly increased load, most moving parts have to be replaces with custom ones, which negatively affects accuracy and reliability.
Burst-fire mode

Compromise between full-auto and semi-auto modes. Requires a new slide, however due to an insignificant increase in load on moving parts, they do not require replacement. Allows to increase the gun's effectiveness to the level of a fully automatic version, at a significantly lower decrease in accuracy.
Tactical flashlight
Long-range narrow beam flashlight is essential for night raids, as well as to seach and clear poorly lit rooms. Does not interfere with the laser sight and can be installed along with it.
